title: 新加坡启动200余门AI培训课程
titleEn: Singapore launches over 200 AI training courses
summary: 新加坡推出200多门AI课程，符合条件者可获6个月免费AI工具订阅。
summaryEn: Singapore launches over 200 AI courses with free six-month premium AI tool access for eligible participants through the new Skills and Workforce Development Agency.
speaker: Lawrence Wong
